command_file.text:
param([ValidateSet('http-plain-q5-out32','http-chat-q17-out32','http-tool-call-q294-out32','http-tool-continuation-q85-out32','http-thinking-q19-out512','q7168-out32','q7170-out32','q8191-out32','q7169-out32','q8192-out32','q7169-out512','q8192-out512','q8193-out32')][string]$Case='q8192-out512')
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'
[Console]::OutputEncoding=[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
if(-not [Environment]::MachineName.Equals('baiying',[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)){throw 'Requires baiying'}
$repo='D:\projects\AIMA-public-runtime-tail-20260914'
$sha='24c4304a16a1665701d05444619d46b832c73e43'
if((& git -C $repo rev-parse HEAD).Trim() -ne $sha -or @(& git -C $repo status --porcelain).Count -ne 0){throw 'Source mismatch'}
function Verify-File([string]$Path,[string]$Sha){
    if((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $Path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -ne $Sha){throw ('Changed input: '+$Path)}
}
$runtime=Join-Path $repo 'build\relocated current package r1\AIMA-AMD395-Qwen36-35B-Windows-Engine-v1.0.2-current-stack.20260915.r1'
if(Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $repo 'build\runtime-current-package-r1')){throw 'Original staging directory must remain unavailable'}
$manifestPath=Join-Path $runtime 'runtime-manifest.json'
$manifestSha='fe4ce91b808449f372859def7df362eb8326bcad35fd5c42f9a3575eeea82635'
Verify-File $manifestPath $manifestSha
$manifest=[IO.File]::ReadAllText($manifestPath)|ConvertFrom-Json
if($manifest.repo_commit -ne $sha -or $manifest.dirty_tree -or $manifest.artifacts.Count -ne 268){throw 'Runtime manifest mismatch'}
foreach($e in $manifest.artifacts){
    $p=Join-Path $runtime $e.path
    Verify-File $p $e.sha256
    if((Get-Item -LiteralPath $p).Length -ne $e.bytes){throw 'Runtime size mismatch'}
}
foreach($component in $manifest.source_component_builds.PSObject.Properties){
    $e=$component.Value
    Verify-File $e.metadata.path $e.metadata.sha256
    $m=[IO.File]::ReadAllText($e.metadata.path)|ConvertFrom-Json
    if($m.repo_commit -ne $e.commit -or $m.dirty_tree){throw 'Component source mismatch'}
    Verify-File (Join-Path $runtime $e.package_path) $e.artifact.sha256
}
$cli=Join-Path $runtime 'product-cli\qrt-product.exe'
$cliSha='eccc16fe523693c9547ac3b764c59ee208f1ee61a407ab656af414f522cc08cf'
Verify-File $cli $cliSha
$provider=Join-Path $runtime 'whole-provider\qrt_qwen36_whole_provider.dll'
Verify-File $provider '1f3e8416bbcaae92e2958c971c60c46381e0fdc8ee986430e90671dee2724469'
if($Case.StartsWith('http-')){
    $matrixKind='actual_http_short_prompts'
    $data='D:\projects\gb10-http-short-inputs-20260912-r1'
    $oraclePath=Join-Path $data 'gb10_http_short_actual_tokens_20260912_oracle.json'
    $oracleSha='2c0c496276f376a4148560c0976bdece4c088ddcf7d989afb1e2a58c10718c6b'
    $dataSha='000824a7adb2b16b3e93a3e6bebe8729d328555ffaa12c2fdadd5024d659194d'
}else{
    $matrixKind='full_cold_boundary_shapes'
    $data='D:\projects\gb10-token-matrix-inputs-20260911-r2'
    $oraclePath=Join-Path $repo 'contracts\gb10_cold_token_matrix_20260911_oracle.json'
    $oracleSha='7a6feb488f4dd136e49c4d7227c1fc325e3216af3dae3e9b60aa0b3025f3d1b1'
    $dataSha='e1a2fa36b42487a979b0c4839b001149db20b9130957d0c6fe801609f452339c'
}
Verify-File $oraclePath $oracleSha
$matrix=[IO.File]::ReadAllText($oraclePath)|ConvertFrom-Json
$cases=@($matrix.cases|Where-Object {$_.name -eq $Case})
if($cases.Count -ne 1){throw 'Oracle case missing'}
$oracle=$cases[0]
$dataManifestPath=Join-Path $data 'manifest.json'
Verify-File $dataManifestPath $dataSha
$dataManifest=[IO.File]::ReadAllText($dataManifestPath)|ConvertFrom-Json
$promptPath=Join-Path $data ($Case+'-prompt.json')
$expectedPath=Join-Path $data ($Case+'-expected.json')
foreach($p in @($promptPath,$expectedPath)){Verify-File $p $dataManifest.([IO.Path]::GetFileName($p))}
$name='current-package-matrix-'+$Case+'-r1'
$out=Join-Path $repo ('build\'+$name)
$envPath=Join-Path $repo ('build\'+$name+'.env')
$specPath=Join-Path $repo ('build\'+$name+'.json')
foreach($p in @($out,$envPath,$specPath)){if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $p){throw ('Existing evidence: '+$p)}}
$profilePath=Join-Path $runtime 'runtime.env'
$profileSha='a8b0a9d17716268ddc6e5eb82a98abba498153b24727536cb65e7f3264c5b11f'
Verify-File $profilePath $profileSha
$original=[IO.File]::ReadAllText($profilePath)
$portableCount=([regex]::Matches($original,[regex]::Escape('${RUNTIME_DIR}'))).Count
if($portableCount -ne 33 -or $original -notmatch '(?m)^QRT_QWEN36_PREFIX_CHECKPOINTS=0\r?$' -or $original -notmatch '(?m)^QRT_QWEN36_DYNAMIC_LOGICAL_MOE_PROVIDER=0\r?$'){throw 'Profile mismatch'}
$resolved=$original.Replace('${RUNTIME_DIR}',$runtime.Replace('\','/'))
if($resolved.Contains('${RUNTIME_DIR}') -or $resolved -match '(?m)^QRT_\w*DUMP_PREFIX=.+$'){throw 'Unresolved or tracing profile'}
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($envPath,$resolved,[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
$spec=[ordered]@{
    executable=$cli;working_directory=$repo;repo_commit=$sha;cli_commit=$sha;cli_sha256=$cliSha
    cli_build_metadata_sha256=$manifest.source_component_builds.cli.metadata.sha256
    command_file=$PSCommandPath;command_file_sha256=(Get-FileHash $PSCommandPath -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
    model='D:\models\Qwen3.6-35B-A3B'
    arguments=@('run','--model','D:\models\Qwen3.6-35B-A3B','--tokens',$promptPath,'--output-tokens',[string]$oracle.expected.continuation_token_count,'--expected-output',$expectedPath,'--expected-prompt-fnv',$oracle.prompt.u32le_fnv1a64,'--expected-output-fnv',$oracle.expected.output_token_ids_u32le_fnv1a64,'--env-file',$envPath,'--provider-dll',$provider)
    oracle=$oraclePath;oracle_sha256=$oracleSha;oracle_case=$Case;matrix_kind=$matrixKind
    reference_case_sha256=$oracle.capture_case_sha256;reference_data_manifest_sha256=$dataSha
    prompt_file_sha256=(Get-FileHash $promptPath -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
    expected_file_sha256=(Get-FileHash $expectedPath -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
    runtime_directory=$runtime;runtime_manifest=$manifestPath;runtime_manifest_sha256=$manifestSha
    runtime_artifacts_verified=$manifest.artifacts.Count;component_commits=$manifest.component_commits
    component_builds=$manifest.source_component_builds;source_profile_sha256=$profileSha
    portable_paths_resolved=$portableCount;environment_sha256=(Get-FileHash $envPath -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
    environment_options_overridden=@();original_staging_directory_unavailable=$true
    cold_prefill_seed_included=$true;prefix_checkpoints_enabled=$false;model_loaded_from_new_process=$true
    purpose='GB10-anchored cold regression using the relocated current portable package, with its packaged CLI and providers. Only portable paths are expanded for the C loader; no numerical or dispatch options are overridden. All output IDs, first logit and actual callbacks must pass. Immutable performance gates remain unchanged.'
}
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($specPath,($spec|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 14),[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
$env:PATH='C:\Program Files\AMD\ROCm\7.1\bin;'+$env:PATH
& (Join-Path $repo 'scripts\baiying_guarded_inference.ps1') -SpecPath $specPath -OutDir $out -TimeoutSeconds 300|Out-Null
$r=[IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path $out 'run-record.json'))|ConvertFrom-Json
$r|Select-Object reason,exit_code,wall_ms,summary,host_checks|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6
if($r.reason -ne 'completed' -or -not $r.host_checks_pass -or $r.exit_code -ne 0){throw 'Product or host guard failed'}
$observed=@($r.summary.output_token_ids);$expected=@($oracle.expected.output_token_ids)
$same=$observed.Count -eq $expected.Count
for($i=0;$same -and $i -lt $expected.Count;$i++){if($observed[$i] -ne $expected[$i]){$same=$false}}
if(-not $same -or $r.summary.prompt_token_ids_fnv1a64 -ne $oracle.prompt.u32le_fnv1a64 -or -not $r.summary.first_token_raw_logit_available -or [Math]::Abs($r.summary.first_token_raw_logit-$oracle.expected.first_token_raw_logit) -gt $oracle.expected.first_token_raw_logit_tolerance){throw 'GB10 token/logit boundary failed'}
if(-not $r.summary.stream_matches_output -or -not $r.summary.callbacks_before_return -or $r.summary.stream_callback_count -ne $expected.Count){throw 'Actual stream callback boundary failed'}
exit 0

scope: Every case loads the real model in a separate native process using the same relocated package and packaged CLI/whole provider. All268 runtime assets and source component metadata are verified before execution. Only33 portable paths are expanded; numerical and dispatch options remain unchanged. The frozen real prompt IDs, every output ID, first logit within0.125 and actual callback sequence establish correctness. Self-hashes remain diagnostic. The short matrix uses actual HTTP-tokenized text/chat/tool/thinking prompts through the CLI. These case-specific clocks are not retained-performance acceptance. Long contexts and soak require separate evidence.
